title: Algorithmic Authority and the Clinical Standard of Care
abstract: arXiv:2606.00044v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence into clinical medicine creates a fundamental tension between algorithmic probabilistic reasoning and the experiential intuition of expert physicians; applying Lawrence Lessig's \enquote{Code is Law} framework, I argue that the architecture of clinical AI systems already functions as de facto medical regulation, reshaping liability and the standard of care. Reframing AI \enquote{hallucination} as structurally analogous to well-documented human cognitive failures such as confirmation bias and premature diagnostic closure, I show that both failure modes demand a unified governance response. I therefore propose a dialectical standard of care that treats the integrated AI-physician dyad as the singular responsible diagnostic entity, mandating the synthesis of algorithmic precision with human interpretive authority within robust data governance and patient privacy frameworks.

translated_title: 算法权威与临床诊疗标准
translated_abstract: 将人工智能整合入临床医学，在算法概率推理与专家医生的经验直觉之间造成了根本性的张力。本文运用劳伦斯·莱斯格的“代码即法律”框架，论证临床AI系统的架构已经在发挥着事实上的医疗监管功能，重塑了责任归属与诊疗标准。本文将AI“幻觉”重新框定为与已被充分记录的人类认知失误（如确认偏误和过早的诊断闭合）在结构上相类似的现象，并指出这两种失败模式都需要统一的治理回应。因此，本文提出一种辩证的诊疗标准，将整合的“AI-医生”二元体视为单一的责任诊断主体，要求在健全的数据治理和患者隐私框架内，实现算法精确性与人类解释权威的综合。
tldr: 本文借助“代码即法律”框架论证临床AI系统已成为事实上的医疗监管，并提出将AI与医生视为单一责任诊断实体的辩证诊疗标准，从而对AI幻觉与人类认知失误这两类失败模式进行统一治理。
en_tdlr: Applying the "Code is Law" framework, this paper argues that clinical AI systems already function as de facto medical regulation and proposes a dialectical standard of care treating the AI-physician dyad as a single responsible diagnostic entity to unify the governance of both AI hallucination and human cognitive failure.
